SRC-213:R001.text: Do not attribute this incident to Gemini, another agent, or any previous change without concrete evidence.

SRC-213:R002.text: Do not interpret Test-Path False alone as proof that the directory does not exist.

SRC-213:R003.text: Do not automatically create an inaccessible directory.

SRC-213:R004.text: Avoid uncontrolled traceback in normal CLI output.

SRC-213:R006.text: Do not convert access denial into a warning that permits unsafe execution.

SRC-213:R007.text: A permission failure must remain a hard boundary for operations requiring that resource.

SRC-213:R008.text: The host account must have only the permissions genuinely required for the authorized project.

SRC-213:R010.text: Any privileged ACL mutation must remain an explicit operator-authorized action.

SRC-213:R011.text: An AG3 host failure must not automatically block unrelated SAIPEN Work.

SRC-213:R012.text: Do not repeatedly retry the identical permission failure without a changed prerequisite.

SRC-213:R013.text: Do not invent a global recovery event merely to release unrelated Work.

SRC-213:R020.text: No canonical partial writes on failure.

SRC-213:R021.text: No false INIT or VERIFY completion.

SRC-213:R024.text: Preserve the active goal and Work ownership; inspect live state before admitting this incident, and continue independently admissible Work without preemption or force release.

SRC-213:R025.text: Identify the exact manifest call chain and ancestor operation; distinguish missing path, access denial, inaccessible ancestor, invalid binding, missing dependency and actual canonical corruption using admissible evidence.

SRC-213:R026.text: Catch the relevant permission and OS failures at the lifecycle boundary, retain the original Windows error and offending path, and return a structured actionable runtime-unavailable result with effective identity where available and before-admission versus validation stage.

SRC-213:R027.text: Keep documented JSON error paths parseable, prohibit uncontrolled traceback, preserve canonical state without partial writes, and never fabricate successful INIT or VERIFY.

SRC-213:R028.text: Inspect ancestor traversal and target-root ACLs separately using read-only diagnostics; never grant broad recursive access or Full Control, modify ACLs, disable isolation, change ownership, expose unrelated projects, or alter AUDAPACK recovery authority.

SRC-213:R029.text: If access is necessary, report the exact narrow operator-authorized adjustment; preserve intentional isolation and recommend an authorized alternative project binding or broker route when policy denies it.

SRC-213:R030.text: Record the affected operation as BLOCKED with evidence and resumable position while its resource remains unavailable; suppress identical retries until a prerequisite changes and resume through canonical validation after repair.

SRC-213:R031.text: Prove accessible and missing roots, denied ancestor and child, denied manifest inspection, parseable JSON, zero canonical partial writes, no false completion, independent scheduling and unchanged account isolation with focused and neighboring regressions.
